settings.title: Settings
system.title: System
system.subtitle: Context window, summary compaction and where local data lives.
system.rmb.title: Coin animation
system.rmb.desc: Every 0.1 CNY of cumulative spend makes a coin pop up and flip on the sidebar usage button. Turn it off if it distracts you; usage tracking is not affected.
system.rmb.on: Currently: on, plays when spend reaches 0.1 CNY
system.rmb.onTitle: Click to turn the coin animation off
system.rmb.offTitle: Click to turn the coin animation on
system.close.title: When closing the window
system.close.desc: Decides what the ✕ in the title bar does. Minimizing to tray keeps EZNess running in the background so tasks in progress are not interrupted; double-click the tray icon to come back, right-click it to quit.
system.close.label: Close window behavior
system.close.hint: The first close asks once, with "minimize to tray" preselected, and remembers your answer. You can change it here at any time.
system.storage.title: Storage location
system.storage.desc: Settings, prompts, knowledge, warehouse and voice models live here. "Change location" copies the existing data to a folder you choose and verifies it; only after that succeeds does the app switch over and delete the old copy.
system.storage.migrateConfirm:
Move app data to:
{path}

The app will create ezrag (knowledge) and ezstorge (warehouse) there, and move settings, prompts, voice models and Python runtimes as well.
After migration the old location is deleted, and the target folder must not already contain Ezness data.
system.storage.totalInfo: Total {total} · Knowledge {rag} ({files} files / {chunks} chunks) · Warehouse {warehouse} ({count} files) · Voice models {voiceReady} ({voiceSize})
system.tree.title: Folder layout
system.tree.desc: The address uses a fixed layout. Knowledge and warehouse each have their own folder and never read or write each other's files.
system.tree.rag: Knowledge: SQLite index and original file copies
system.tree.warehouse: Warehouse: manifest and original images/files from chats
system.tree.locales: Language packs: your own interface translations (optional)
system.tree.runtimes: Python runtime: the interpreter and modules used by custom features; moves together with the rest
system.tree.settings: Providers, default models, web access and recording device
system.tree.kb: Knowledge chunking, retrieval and embedding settings
system.cache.title: About system caches
system.cache.desc: Electron's own browser caches (Cache, GPUCache, ShaderCache, etc.) stay in your Windows user folder. They are not app data and do not move with the storage location; deleting them simply rebuilds them.
system.language.title: Interface language
system.language.desc: The language used by the interface. Language packs are plain JSON files in the language folder; adding a new language does not require changing the app.
system.language.label: Interface language
system.language.hint: English coverage is being added page by page; untranslated pages fall back to Chinese. Put a pack in the folder above, then click "Refresh packs".
system.language.openError: Could not open the language folder
system.language.desktopOnly: The language folder is only available in the desktop app.
system.language.errors: {count} language pack(s) could not be read: {files}
context.title: Maximum context
context.desc: The small ring at the bottom-right of the composer uses this number to show how full the context is. The ring reads the actual usage reported by the model for the latest request, which already includes the system prompt, tool definitions and all messages; text estimation is used only before the first request. Workspace tasks compact their conversation before each request, and the ring still shows actual usage. A chat compacts automatically at 90%.
context.aria: Maximum context for a single chat
context.hint: Default 128000 (128K). Enter the context length your model actually supports, or click a common preset. A value larger than the real window only makes the provider reject the request at its true limit.
context.keep.title: Turns kept when compacting
context.keep.desc: When you click the ring to compact, the most recent turns stay verbatim and earlier content is merged into a summary card. The original is archived and can be restored at any time.
context.keep.aria: Number of recent turns kept when compacting
context.keep.hint: Default 3 turns (1–10). The summary is generated by the current chat's model in a separate request, so it will not interrupt an answer in progress.
